summary: Verified critical fix: CRA bundle now points to production Render backend and admin login works end-to-end. Static bundle inspection + live Playwright login flow both confirm zero references to Emergent preview URL.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix for hardcoded REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is fully verified. Bundle main.fc546c05.js everywhere (local /tmp/dwv6, CRA build, ZIP) references only https://electroyes-api.onrender.com. Live login with admin/electroyes2026 succeeds, dashboard renders with Productos/Pedidos tabs, no emergentagent.com traffic. ZIP is ready to deploy to DonWeb.
rca of the issue: Original bug: previous CRA build embedded the Emergent preview URL as REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL at compile time, so once deployed to DonWeb the compiled JS fetched auth from the preview backend (different DB) instead of Render. Fix: rebuilt CRA with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://electroyes-api.onrender.com and regenerated the ZIP. Verified by grep of the bundle and by live network capture during login.
